result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: duplicate identical restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section and a truncated restaurant name in the same section.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two consecutive identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, delivery time, and delivery fee, making the list look broken or duplicated.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list so each merchant appears only once, and verify the data feed feeding the carousel.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows the restaurant name as 'Smash Bros Bu', with the rest of the title cut off and no ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap, truncate with an ellipsis, or adjust card widths so full names are readable without clipping.
